# Design point P004

## Description

The system exposes repositories through Git packfile-based networking while maintaining incremental commit-graph files for reachable commits, reducing repeated graph-update cost. Repository writes are accepted only after synchronous commitment establishes the required durability guarantee; these choices have no evident conflict.
